images.caption: A famous view of the Knaresborough Viaduct across the River Nidd. The Church of St John the Baptist can be seen in the background, obscured by trees. This photo is taken from the hill after which the town is named, the site of the ruins of Knaresborough Castle (borough derives from an Old English word meaning ‘fortress’).
